_comment: Documents for ANI assistant retrieval. Every URL was verified (HTTP 200) on 2026-11-05. CPCRI documents come from its Free Publications page (cpcri.gov.in/page/publications_free_by_type/50). A PDF without trustworthy text is read by OCR automatically; set "ocr" to force or never to override. publication_date is only set when the document itself (or its official page) states it; publication_date_evidence records where. Add a document only when its publisher permits reading and quoting with attribution. Scanned tables can hold OCR digit errors, so the assistant never lets a model restate numbers from scanned passages. Not added: Kannada root-grub folder arecanutk.pdf (scan too poor for OCR), CPCRI Technical Bulletin 39 CP2809.pdf (over the 25 MB limit), ARECA_KANNADA_2018Pdf.pdf and calareca011.pdf (poorer copies of documents already listed).
